author: Ryan Prior

images.alt: Nathalie Timtchenko practiced as a therapist in Kyiv for nearly a decade before founding a nonprofit that offers free psychological support during Russia's war against Ukraine.
Ukrainian families who participated in art therapy activities at a summer camp reported a 35 percent decrease in symptoms associated with PTSD.

# A Harvard Graduate Aims to Transform Ukrainian Mental Health

> Therapist Nathalie Timtchenko rallied more than 1,000 therapists around the world to create First Aid of the Soul, offering free psychological support to Ukrainians during the war.
